prompt: A Scavrats (Scavrat), a Star Wars canon creature. Scavrats were large, omnivorous rodents of unknown planetary origin albeit common enough on multiple worlds that they were considered pests. They were often mistaken for the Tattooinian Womp Rat, but the big behavioural distinction here being that they were not predatory and far more sociable creatures despite their strange appearance. RimWorld top-down pawn sprite, desert-world creature, painterly game-art style matching the existing RimWorld/Star Wars mod roster, clean silhouette, transparent background.
style_notes: RimWorld creature sprite, Star Wars desert bestiary, our own art (not the donor mod's).
